inputs.name: registerGenerateCommand.program
inputs.description: The Commander program instance that receives the generate command tree when registration runs. The implementation calls its command builder API, so this must be a Commander Command instance.

outputs.name: registerGenerateCommand
outputs.description: The function returns no value after registering the generate command, alias, subcommands, options, and action handlers. Command actions run later when Commander dispatches them.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: The component scaffold action throws this when a truthy --level value is neither molecule nor organism. The failure message directs native atom generation to generate elements.
